trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. There is nothing extra to do for it: no multiplayer, no DLC and no second playthrough are needed. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4 out of 10 and puts the platinum at about 200 hours, Push Square at 250 hours or more, so treat this as a long project rather than a weekend. Use the Planner tab to work through the list in order and watch the remaining-time estimate shrink.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
The platinum unlocks immediately after the last one.

sources.label: PowerPyx trophy guide — difficulty 4/10, ~200 hours, no multiplayer or DLC
Push Square trophy guide — up to 300 hours or more

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It unlocks when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 — the first mission of the game. Just play the story; there is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss.
steps: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to its end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes the chapter trophies pop a little late — after you clear the first mission or two of the next chapter — so do not worry if it does not appear the instant the chapter ends. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing that might matter later: the optional balcony meditation with Lucia (see Positive Mental Attitude).
steps: Finish every Chapter 1 story mission.
If the trophy has not popped, play the first mission of Chapter 2 — it lands shortly after.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 3. Several side strands open in this chapter — Andy's strand starts with a phone call, Randy's sports-car wish list opens, and Tyrone's lab strand begins — so take the calls and meet the new contacts as they appear; all of them stay available after the story.
steps: Finish every Chapter 3 story mission.
Answer Andy's phone call when it comes, and meet Randy and Tyrone as their strands open.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 4. Three of the six mission-specific story trophies sit in this chapter, and the bank-job chain opens through an optional mission here — take it when it appears, because bank vaults feed both Maximum Withdrawal and the 100% checklist.
steps: Finish every Chapter 4 story mission.
Take the optional mission that opens bank jobs when it appears.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable, and the only gold in the story set. It unlocks when you finish the final mission. After the credits you return to free roam and the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — that is when the real cleanup begins. Keep a manual save at the end of each chapter as you go: there is no mission replay, and PowerPyx suggests rotating the 15 manual save slots that way.
steps: Finish the final mission.
After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see the cleanup checklist.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set and the longest single grind — worth 100 Gamerscore on Xbox, the biggest single award. The 100% Completion checklist appears only after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, but progress you made during the story already counts. PowerPyx calls the checklist lenient — closer to 60% true completion — because most of it asks for part of a total, not all of it. The parts that need everything are the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's hunting quests. Key numbers from PowerPyx: 100 optional tasks, 39 of 39 gang operations, 22 of 22 bank jobs, 7 of 7 Payday Loan jobs, 34 of 35 smash 'n' grabs, 50 of 91 stick-ups, 8 of 8 vaults, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 of 33 underwater discoveries, 30 of 34 magazines/books/comics, 15 of 18 meditation spots, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 15 Bret target decks, 300 of 397 stunts, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 50 of 66 weapons found, 100 of 255 animals studied. Nothing on the checklist is missable — everything can still be done in free roam after the credits. Budget about 100 hours for this stage alone.
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work the checklist top to bottom; the 'needs everything' rows (robberies, underwater, ranges, drone races, Bret) first, since they gate other trophies too.
Leave the 10 hardest of the 80 challenges undone — only 70 are needed.

sources.label: PowerPyx 100% Completion Checklist & Guide — every requirement and count
PowerPyx trophy guide — hardest trophy, ~100 hours for this step
Push Square trophy guide — 100% checklist opens after the story

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts of any kind. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in the world — 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — and the 100% checklist needs 300 of them, so keep going past 250. Stunts you do naturally while driving count, but the reliable way is to work the stunt jumps and bridge flights deliberately: a stunt registers when you land one, and the game tracks them under your stats. Do this alongside the 100% cleanup, not as a separate chore at the very end.
steps: Do stunt jumps, bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps — any mix counts.
Keep going to 300 stunts: the 100% checklist needs them.

sources.label: PowerPyx 100% checklist — 397 stunts: 130 jumps, 202 under bridges, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps
Sixshore trophy list — 100% needs 300 stunts

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. PowerPyx lists them as fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. None of them needs to be won or finished well — one attempt at each is enough. The quickest route is to sample them as you pass them during the story: fish once with Cal, play one round of pool or basketball, enter one race, try one shooting-range challenge and one stunt. This is a good early trophy because every activity you try also feeds other trophies and the 100% checklist.
steps: Try one of each: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race, a stunt.
One attempt each is enough — you do not need to win.

sources.label: Sixshore trophy list — the 9 activity types per PowerPyx
PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The 100% checklist needs all 42 as well, so there is no shortcut around them. PowerPyx says the gold medals are not too difficult. Work through the ranges one weapon class at a time, and retry a challenge immediately while the layout is fresh in your mind — the range lets you replay freely. Shooting ranges also count as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so your first visit there does double duty.
steps: Visit a shooting range and open its challenge list.
Earn gold in all 42 challenges; retry a failed one at once while the layout is fresh.

sources.label: PowerPyx trophy guide — shooting range golds are not too difficult
PowerPyx 100% checklist — 42 of 42 shooting range gold medals required

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. The 100% checklist goes further and needs all 42 drone time trials completed, so winning the races is the first half of a bigger job — do the time trials at each location while you are there. Drone races are a flying skill check more than a speed check: learn each course's line once, then run it clean.
steps: Find each of the 14 Top Fun drone race locations.
Win the race at each one; clear the time trials there too for the 100% checklist.

sources.label: Sixshore trophy list — 14 Top Fun locations
PowerPyx 100% checklist — 42 of 42 drone time trials required

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different matters: winning the same race twenty times does not count. The 100% checklist needs 30 of 40 unique races won, plus 10 of 13 race challenge gold medals, so aim past 20 and treat this as part of the racing cleanup. Enter a race once, learn its route, and move on to the next one rather than grinding a favourite.
steps: Enter races across Leonida and win 20 different ones.
Keep going to 30 unique wins for the 100% checklist.

sources.label: PowerPyx 100% checklist — 30 of 40 unique races won, 10 of 13 race challenge golds

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. You meet Cal in Chapter 1, and after that he texts you a fishing spot — follow the text and take the challenge. Fishing is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, and Cal's fishing counts toward the optional tasks the 100% checklist needs, so answer his messages when they come.
steps: Meet Cal in Chapter 1.
When he texts you a fishing spot, go there and beat him in the fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any one in-game video game through to the end. Three of them run on the TV at home and a fourth sits on arcade machines out in the world. Pick the shortest one you enjoy and finish it — completing it is what counts, not a high score. Playing a video game is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
steps: Play a video game on the TV at home or on an arcade machine.
Finish it to the end.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's side strand. Lucia only. It starts with a phone call in Chapter 3 — answer it and follow the strand through to its final mission. Side strands stay available after the story, so if you miss the call, the strand can still be picked up later; nothing about Andy is missable.
steps: Answer Andy's phone call in Chapter 3 (Lucia only).
Play Andy's missions through to the final one.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure diving strand: 7 shipwrecks in total. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns later, so do not panic if he disappears for a while — the strand is not missable and he comes back. Dive each wreck, collect what is there, and play his missions through to the final one. Kenton's sets also feed the 100% checklist, which needs 5 of 7 Kenton sets completed.
steps: Meet Kenton early, then pick his strand back up when he returns later in the story.
Dive all 7 shipwrecks and finish his final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Not every side questline counts — PowerPyx is still confirming exactly which strands qualify — so the safe approach is to finish more than eight: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret, Cal and the other stranger strands each count toward the pool. This trophy is not part of the 100% checklist, so it is the natural final stage after the checklist is done; every strand can still be finished after the story.
steps: Finish the stranger strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret, Cal and others).
Finish more than eight to be safe — PowerPyx is still confirming which strands qualify.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's wish list of 16 sports cars. It opens in Chapter 3. Randy wants specific cars delivered, so the work is finding each model, taking it, and bringing it to him — scanning cars with the WAiNK app as you go helps you learn which models you have already seen. Randy's wish list also pays the most for fenced cars, which helps the 100% checklist's $200,000 vehicles-fenced row. The strand stays open after the story.
steps: Meet Randy from Chapter 3 and take his wish list.
Find and deliver all 16 sports cars, then finish his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot — 18 spots at 10 locations, and the 100% checklist needs 15 of them. This is the only trophy any guide flags as possibly missable, so handle it early. During Chapter 1, one morning at Jason's house after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia says she is going to meditate and walks out to the balcony. Follow her and accept the optional quest: she shows you how meditation works. PowerPyx reports that this balcony meditation raises the meditation counter by one, but it is not marked as a meditation spot like the other 18, so it is unclear whether the trophy needs it — PowerPyx's author had done it when the trophy unlocked. Do it when it comes up; it takes a minute and removes the risk. Then visit all 18 marked spots across Leonida. Push Square lists no known missables, but the one-minute precaution costs nothing.
steps: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth: one morning at Jason's house, follow Lucia to the balcony and accept her meditation invitation.
Then meditate at all 18 marked spots across Leonida (15 are needed for 100%).

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of 18. There are 480 cards in all, and the 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 sets, so three sets is only the start — keep collecting well past this trophy. Cards are scattered across Leonida; pick them up as you travel rather than hunting them in one sitting, and use the collectibles tracking in your stats to see which sets are closest to complete.
steps: Collect cards across Leonida and complete any 3 full sets.
Keep going to 15 of 18 sets for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK phone app. Landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count. This is the same app you use to scan vehicles for Whip It Good, so make scanning a habit from the start of the game: whenever you pass something new, open WAiNK and scan it. The 100% checklist needs exactly 100 WAiNK locations, so this trophy and that checklist row finish together.
steps: Open the WAiNK app on the in-game phone whenever you pass a landmark, curiosity or sculpture.
Scan 100 locations; the 100% checklist needs the same 100.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges, in eight groups of ten. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this trophy comes on the way to that bigger number — and the gap is deliberate: you get to skip the 10 hardest challenges entirely. Work through the easy and medium groups first, and leave the ones that fight you until you have the gear and skills from the rest of the cleanup.
steps: Complete challenges across the eight groups of ten.
Reach 50 for this trophy, then 70 for the 100% checklist — the 10 hardest can be skipped.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape the heat. It becomes possible once both characters can roam together in Chapter 2. The easy way is to let a bank job do the work: bank jobs give you 4 stars anyway, so finish the job with your partner beside you, then break line of sight, get out of the search area and wait for the stars to clear. Do not try it in the middle of a mission timer — do it in free roam with a fast car and a hiding spot in mind.
steps: Roam with your partner (possible from Chapter 2).
Build a 4-star wanted level — a bank job gives you one anyway.
Break line of sight and escape the search area until the wanted level clears.

sources.label: Sixshore trophy list — possible from Chapter 2; bank jobs give 4 stars anyway

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level — the trick is the opposite of what it sounds like: you must keep the wanted level alive across all three robberies, not lose it. Pick three shops close together, rob them one after another with your partner, and keep moving between them. PowerPyx says the trophy pops about 30 seconds after the third shop. Have a getaway car ready before the first robbery, and do not stop to fight the police between shops.
steps: Pick three shops close together and park a fast getaway car nearby.
With your partner, rob all three in a row without letting the wanted level clear.
Wait about 30 seconds after the third shop for the trophy to pop.

sources.label: Sixshore trophy list — pops about 30 seconds after the third shop, per PowerPyx

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning them with the WAiNK app is enough — you do not have to drive them. Make it a habit from the first hour: scan every new vehicle you pass, in traffic, in car parks and at dealerships. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so 100 is only the halfway mark; keep scanning and this trophy arrives on its own.
steps: Scan every new vehicle you see with the WAiNK app.
Reach 100 discovered; keep going to 200 for the 100% checklist.

sources.label: Sixshore trophy list — scanning with WAiNK is enough, you do not have to drive them
PowerPyx 100% checklist — 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. The key detail, from PowerPyx, is who counts: gang members count, while soldiers, police and civilians seem not to. So do this in a gang fight, not a police shootout. Find a gang operation or a spot where gang members gather in a group, trigger Combat Focus when five or more are in view, and take them down before the focus ends. If it fails, reset and try again — gang operations give you plenty of attempts.
steps: Find a group of gang members — gang operations are ideal.
Trigger Combat Focus with five or more in view and take down 5 before it ends.
Avoid police and soldiers for this one: they seem not to count.

sources.label: Sixshore trophy list — gang members count, soldiers, police and civilians seem not to, per PowerPyx
Exophase — official list

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet docked at a gate at Vice City International Airport and fly about 1 km away. Go to the airport in free roam, find a jet parked at a gate, get aboard and take off — the trophy is about the departure, not a destination, so any direction works once you are airborne. Expect police attention on the ground; board quickly and get the jet moving.
steps: Go to Vice City International Airport in free roam.
Board a passenger jet docked at a gate and take off.
Fly about 1 km away from the airport.

sources.label: Sixshore trophy list — steal a passenger jet docked at a gate and fly about 1 km away
Exophase — official list

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. PowerPyx found tanks at Mile Zero Air Station in the southwest of the map. Drive in, take the tank and get out — the base will fight back, so go in with a plan for the exit and a vehicle waiting outside. The Rhino is the series' classic tank, and the trophy's description is a nod to that.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station in the southwest.
Steal a tank and drive it out.

sources.label: Sixshore trophy list — PowerPyx found tanks at Mile Zero Air Station in the southwest
Exophase — official list

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which a Chapter 3 main mission gives you — so this trophy cannot be done before Chapter 3. Plan the robbery quietly: case the store, take the valuables without tripping an alarm or being spotted, and leave before anyone raises it. If you are detected, the attempt fails; leave and try again.
steps: Reach Chapter 3 and get the Snap Gun from the main mission that provides it.
Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

sources.label: Sixshore trophy list — you need the Snap Gun, given by a Chapter 3 main mission

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4. There are 8 vaults in total, and the 100% checklist needs all 8 hit, so five is a milestone on the way to eight. Each vault robbery ends with an escape — losing the wanted level after the robbery is part of the job, so plan your exit route before you go in, and pair this with Hot Together, since bank jobs hand you the 4-star wanted level that trophy needs.
steps: Take the optional mission in Chapter 4 that opens bank jobs.
Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one.
Keep going to all 8 vaults for the 100% checklist.

sources.label: Sixshore trophy list — bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4; 8 vaults, 100% needs all of them
PowerPyx 100% checklist — 8 of 8 vaults hit

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The first bank job counts for this, so it may pop on its own while you work on Maximum Withdrawal. If you want it earlier, you can blow open a truck's back door with a sticky bomb and take what is inside, then escape. Either way, the escape matters as much as the robbery — break line of sight and clear the wanted level.
steps: Find an armored truck in traffic, or let the first bank job cover it.
Blow the back door open with a sticky bomb if doing it in free roam.
Take the cash and escape.

sources.label: Sixshore trophy list — the first bank job counts, or blow the back door open with a sticky bomb
Exophase — official list

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the entire map. A plane is the fastest way to do it: fly a grid over the state and watch the map fill in. You will cover most of the state naturally by playing the story and the side strands, so leave the last foggy corners for the cleanup stage and finish them in one or two flights.
steps: Play the story and side strands — most of the map clears naturally.
Take a plane and fly over the remaining foggy areas until the map is fully revealed.

sources.label: Sixshore trophy list — clear the fog from the entire map; a plane is fastest

trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 gang operations in total and the 100% checklist needs all 39 cleared, so this trophy is the first ninth of a much bigger job — start operations early and clear them as you find them rather than leaving all 39 for the end. Each gang has its own operations, so vary your targets and watch your stats to see which gangs you have covered.

Cover all 9 gangs, then keep going — the 100% checklist needs all 39 operations.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all 3 key valuables from the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn. This is a gang operation with a bowling-alley setting, not a game of bowling: clear the operation and take the three valuables it holds. The robbery comes back later if you miss it, so it is not missable. It also counts toward the 39 gang operations the 100% checklist needs.

Clear it and take all 3 key valuables.

trophies.guide: Max out strength on both Jason and Lucia. Work out together and both make progress — that is the partnership the description points at. Use the gyms and workout spots across Leonida regularly during the story rather than leaving it to the end: strength builds slowly, and doing it together means one session counts for both characters. Check each character's stats to see how close to max they are.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Do 500 things that change your criminal profile. This one comes naturally: almost everything you do in Leonida — missions, robberies, activities, choices — feeds the criminal profile, and the counter climbs without you chasing it. Turn on progress and criminal profile notifications in the UI settings so you can see what counts, and by the time you are deep into the 100% cleanup this trophy will already have popped.
steps: Turn on progress and criminal profile notifications in the UI settings.
Play normally — missions, robberies and activities all count toward the 500.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts (fences). It adds up across robberies, so every bank vault, shop robbery and gang operation that pays in marked bills moves the total. The dye pack jammer — the tool that makes laundering work — unlocks in a Chapter 3 main mission, so this trophy cannot be finished before then. The 100% checklist needs the same $250,000 fenced, so this trophy and that checklist row finish together.
steps: Reach Chapter 3 and unlock the dye pack jammer in the main mission that provides it.
Launder marked bills through fences after robberies until $250,000 is reached.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos get you there fastest — buy the expensive weapons and upgrades you actually want rather than throwing money away, and the total climbs on its own during a normal playthrough. If you are close at the end, a round of car mods or a shopping spree closes the gap. It pairs naturally with the money you earn from bank vaults and fences.
steps: Buy guns, car mods and tattoos — the fastest way to spend.
Spend $100,000 in total across all shops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages. PowerPyx puts the total at $160,000, and the real estate app that sells them arrives in Chapter 2. Buy garages as you can afford them — they also give you the space you need to register vehicles for On the Spot, so pair the two trophies. Bank vaults are the best late-game earner if you are short on cash.
